rows.key: i18nKeys:Kick Chat Translator listens to chat in real time and translates non-English (or non-target-language) messages right under the original. No tracking, no account, fully open-source.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:The extension reads each chat message from the page as it appears.
i18nKeys:Each chat message is parsed; emotes and links are stripped before translation.
i18nKeys:The extension picks the first available provider in your chain.
i18nKeys:Translations are cached locally in IndexedDB to avoid duplicate calls.
i18nKeys:Background Kick tabs won't translate (saves DeepL quota while you're away).
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:Larger = more hits across sessions, more disk space.
i18nKeys:Hard cap to avoid hammering providers on fast chats.
i18nKeys:"Reset all settings" restores defaults. Use it if translations stop appearing because a filter (channel allowlist or source-language allowlist) was left active.
i18nKeys:Auto reads incoming chat in your own language, detected from the browser.
i18nKeys:Auto detects the channel's broadcast language from Kick. No manual picking.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:On a new line under the message.
i18nKeys:In a pill after the original text.
i18nKeys:Show floating bar at top of chat (toggle live)
i18nKeys:Click inserts into the chat box (off = copy to clipboard instead)
i18nKeys:Translate what you type before sending. A live preview appears above the chat box; click it to drop the translation in. Uses the same engine and providers as incoming chat.
i18nKeys:On-device = local Chromium models: unlimited, instant, private, no rate-limit. Each language needs a one-time model download (click a flag below, or the "Local" chip in chat).
i18nKeys:Leave empty to translate every detected language. Pick specific ones to ONLY translate those (e.g. only JA + KO).
i18nKeys:Skip messages already in target language
i18nKeys:Used when on-device is off or a language pair isn't downloaded. Providers are tried in order; failing ones are temporarily skipped (exponential cooldown).
i18nKeys:Spend DeepL only on the European languages it clearly wins at; other targets (Japanese, Arabic, Hindi…) use the free engines first, so your DeepL quota lasts much longer.
i18nKeys:Leave blank to use the default public instance.
i18nKeys:Auto-detects the channel's language. Preview shows above the chat box. Click it to insert.
i18nKeys:Save your configuration to a JSON file, or restore it on another browser.
i18nKeys:Shorter messages are left alone. Raise it to spend less provider quota on busy chats.
i18nKeys:Whether a Kick tab keeps translating once you look away.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:Reusing past translations, and how hard the engines are pushed on a busy chat. The defaults suit most channels.
i18nKeys:Words the engines keep getting wrong for your channels. Each line replaces the left side with the right side, after translating.
i18nKeys:one rule per line, in the form word→replacement
i18nKeys:Why each recent message was translated or left alone. Read from an open Kick tab, kept in memory there, never saved to disk.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:No Kick tab is open. Open a channel, let the chat run, then read again.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:The open Kick tab has not loaded the extension yet. Reload the tab, then read again.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:Nothing recorded yet. Let a chat run for a moment, then read again.
i18nKeys:Show the quick language button in chat
i18nKeys:In place of the original text. Emotes stay.
i18nKeys:The Replace style always hides it.
i18nKeys:Only when you point at the line. Spares your quota.
i18nKeys:The recommended style is the most tested. The other three may still change.

rows.key: i18nKeys:Remember a reading language per channel

i18nKeys:Kick Chat Translator reads chat as it arrives and puts a translation under each message in the language you read. It also translates what you type before you send it. No account, no tracking, open source.
rows.twitch: key text names Kick: new key, all locales

rows.key: i18nKeys:How a message becomes a translation
i18nKeys:The message is read from the page, emotes and links set aside.
i18nKeys:Its language is worked out on the spot, from the script and the words it uses. This answer decides everything after it.
i18nKeys:Filters run: already in your language, too short, a bot, a language you did not pick.
i18nKeys:The cache is asked first, so the same message is never paid for twice.
i18nKeys:Otherwise the first available provider in your chain answers, or the on-device engine if you enabled it.
i18nKeys:The Activity tab shows what each of these steps did for you.
i18nKeys:Messages held back by this cap:
i18nKeys:Nothing picked: every language is translated.
i18nKeys:picked: everything else is left alone.
i18nKeys:No key yet, so DeepL is skipped and the chain moves on.
i18nKeys:These are the languages the allowlist in Filters decides between.
i18nKeys:Open a Kick channel: its chat is translated as it arrives.
